recommendation.verdict: not viable as mouth/ears+brain — voice I/O works, ask_yishu never fires
risks: session.update accepts tools but the model never emits ask_yishu on screen or memory turns
S2/S3 speak a fake 'I'll look' line then end the turn (no 2.5s wait, no relayed answer)
barge-in stop is seconds, not hundreds of ms (S4 p50 speech_started 2556ms)
recommendation.paragraph: Step Plan stepaudio-2.5-realtime + linjiajiejie can do voice in/out (S1 first-audio p50 1469ms / p95 2947ms). session.update accepted nested ask_yishu, but the model called it 0/3 on U2 and 0/3 on U4 and 0/3 on U1. Screen turns only said「好，我这就帮你看看。」then response.done; memory turns said「我得翻翻看。稍等啊。」then done — no function_call, so no 2.5s wait, no bridging-during-wait, no faithfulness score. Interrupt: 2/3 runs stopped (speech_started 2556ms / 9550ms after U3 start; after-text「行，那我先不说话了。」); run 3 died on a flaky websocket. S5 skipped. Verdict: realtime as mouth/ears is plausible; ask_yishu as the brain hand-off is not viable on this model until it actually invokes the tool.
